source: Consolidated from the research passes of 10 to 13/08/2026

evidence_grades.A: Peer-reviewed or primary-source measurement. Trust the number.
evidence_grades.B: Independent measurement, not peer reviewed. Trust the direction.
evidence_grades.C: Vendor self-reported. Trust the existence of the feature, not the magnitude.
evidence_grades.D: Plausible practice with no measurement found. Adopt on reasoning, not evidence.

hardware_constraint.primary: MacBook Pro 16-inch 2026, Mac17,8, M5 Pro, 18-core, 24 GB unified, macOS Tahoe 26
hardware_constraint.secondary: MacBook Pro M1 Pro, MacBookPro18,1, 16 GB

verified_measurements.source: Apple MLX research, 19/11/2025, benchmarked on a 24 GB M5

rules: 30B MoE at Q4 is viable but marginal, leaving little context headroom
Anything requiring 32 GB or more is NOT viable on this fleet
Ollama gates its MLX fast path at 32 GB, so this machine silently uses llama.cpp Metal. Use mlx-lm directly for prefill-heavy work on macOS 26.2+

tiers.hot: PostToolUse hook. Budget under 2 seconds per edited file.
tiers.gate: Stop and SubagentStop gate. Budget seconds.
tiers.scheduled: launchd weekly or CI. Budget minutes.
tiers.subagent: Invoked as a tool by an agent, not on a schedule.
tiers.human: Invoked deliberately by a person. Never automated.

recommended.purpose: Static lint of Postgres DDL for lock hazards before a migration runs
recommended.why: TimescaleDB is extension and hypertable heavy, and a solo operator has no DBA to catch a non-concurrent index build that locks a table in production

recommended.purpose: Property-based contract testing driven by the FastAPI OpenAPI schema
recommended.why: Peer-reviewed result (arXiv 2112.10328) that it finds 1.4x to 4.5x more unique defects than the next-best fuzzer across 16 real services

recommended.purpose: OpenTelemetry GenAI spans for every advisor and Anthropic call
recommended.why: The single largest missed category. One trace answers why an agent did what it did, in minutes rather than by reconstruction
recommended.caveat: GenAI semantic conventions are still mostly Development stability, so attribute names may change. Instrument behind a thin adapter.

recommended.purpose: Encrypted secrets at rest, with age as the key backend
recommended.why: Scanning for leaked secrets is not the same as managing them. gitleaks is already installed and closes only the detection half
1.0 shipped 12/05/2026, default for a 20 million line Instagram codebase, roughly 96 percent typing conformance versus ty at roughly 76 percent
recommended.note: Keep mypy for anything relying on mypy plugins such as Django ORM or SQLAlchemy

recommended.purpose: Structural search and rewrite over tree-sitter ASTs
recommended.why: Fills the structural-not-textual gap for both search and safe refactor, fast enough for the hot path
recommended.risk: Bus factor of one. Single maintainer, PyPI development status still Alpha, funded by GitHub Sponsors

recommended.purpose: SBOM generation and vulnerability scanning of that SBOM

recommended.why: Low false positive, seconds not minutes, so they belong at the gate rather than the weekly job

recommended.purpose: Property-based testing for validation and pure logic
recommended.why: Captures most of the practical benefit of formal methods at a fraction of the learning cost. Maintainer funding via Quansight, METR and Anthropic lowers the usual bus factor risk

recommended.purpose: Direct MLX inference to exploit the M5 Pro Neural Accelerators
recommended.why: Apple measured prefill up to 4.1x faster on M5 versus M4 and decode 19 to 27 percent faster. Ollama will not take this path at 24 GB

recommended.purpose: Task running, git hook backstop, local CI parity
recommended.why: lefthook is the backstop that catches commits made outside Claude Code. just replaces make without the .PHONY footguns. act keeps the Stop gate and CI in parity without pushing

recommended.purpose: VM-per-container sandbox for running agent-generated code
recommended.why: Separate kernel per container, sub-second boot, free, native to macOS 26 which this fleet runs
recommended.limitation: No built-in Docker Compose. Pair with OrbStack if Compose is needed, and note OrbStack requires a paid licence for commercial use

declined.reason: The free Apache-2.0 tier cannot manage extensions, functions, triggers, materialised views, partitions or sequences, all of which TimescaleDB relies on. The Postgres lock linting is Pro-only at 9 USD per seat per month. squawk does that linting for free.
Too slow for routine gating. Meta made it work at scale with LLM assistance, but that assumes a platform team. Run it manually and module-scoped on pricing, auth or financial logic only.
CrossHair, Z3, deal and icontract carry a learning cost that outweighs the benefit for a FastAPI and Next.js shop. Hypothesis captures most of the value.

The one controlled study (128 runs, 32 features, 5 repos) measured a +0.15 improvement on a 1-to-5 judge score, roughly 3 percent. The existing delivery and verification gates already implement the substantive discipline. Adopt the practice of writing acceptance criteria first, not the framework.
Still pre-1.0 on the 0.0.x line with breaking changes possible between releases, and freshly acquired by OpenAI on 19/03/2026. Track it, do not gate on it.
Enterprise overhead for a solo operator unless a client contract requires it. SBOM generation via Syft already covers the practical need.
ast-grep plus ripgrep plus a sqlite-vec index cover the need at this scale.
Heavier than just and act. Earthly maintenance status is uncertain.
Mistral Non-Production Licence forbids commercial use without a separate agreement. A licence trap for a support business.
The 7B GGUF is roughly 26 GB and would compete with the coder model for memory on a 24 GB machine.
Checkov, tfsec, fossa and scancode are client-specific or enterprise overhead. Adopt only when a contract requires it.

risk_register.detail: Still on the 0.1.x line. The author stated the plan is a v1 then maintenance mode, a GitHub issue asks whether it is still maintained, and a community fork exists carrying a notice that the original author is unavailable.
risk_register.mitigation: Keep it, but abstract the vector store behind an interface, pin the version, and document LanceDB as the fallback. Do not treat it as load-bearing without that abstraction.

risk_register.detail: Bus factor of one, PyPI status still Alpha.
risk_register.mitigation: Pin the version. Fallback is ripgrep plus tree-sitter directly.

risk_register.detail: OpenAI acquired Astral (uv, ruff, ty) on 19/03/2026. Tools remain open source but product-plus-talent acquisitions can later become talent-only.
risk_register.mitigation: ruff and uv are safe near term. Do not adopt ty as primary. Note that pyrefly is a Meta project and unaffected.

risk_register.detail: The official GitHub Action was compromised twice in March 2026 by the TeamPCP campaign and package-repo GPG keys were rotated in April 2026.
risk_register.mitigation: Pin to commit SHAs, never to a floating tag.

risk_register.detail: No stable programmatic API until 7.1, and an independent test found the two compilers did not report identical errors.
risk_register.mitigation: Use tsgo as a fast command-line checker at the gate. Do not build tooling on its API yet.

risk_register.detail: Most gen_ai attributes are still Development stability.
risk_register.mitigation: Instrument behind a thin adapter so a rename is a one-file change.

evidence_anchors.note: The quantitative claims worth trusting, separated from the ones that are not.
grade_A: METR RCT (arXiv 2507.09089): 16 experienced developers, 246 real tasks, measured 19 percent SLOWDOWN while developers self-estimated a 20 percent speedup. The February 2026 follow-up shows the effect probably narrowed or reversed but METR labels it an unreliable signal due to 30 to 50 percent task-submission selection bias.

Google Tricorder (Software Engineering at Google): over 50,000 review changes per day, effective false positive rate just under 5 percent, and analysers exceeding roughly 10 percent were routinely disabled by developers.
Schemathesis (arXiv 2112.10328): finds 1.4x to 4.5x more unique defects than the next-best fuzzer across 8 fuzzers and 16 services.
Apple MLX on M5 (19/11/2025): prefill up to 4.1x faster than M4, decode 19 to 27 percent faster, measured on a 24 GB machine.
grade_B_correlational: DORA 2025 (nearly 5,000 respondents): AI adoption now correlates positively with throughput, a reversal from 2024, but still correlates with delivery instability.
CircleCI 2026 (28.7 million workflows, 22,000+ organisations): throughput up 59 percent year on year, main-branch success rate down to 70.8 percent, the lowest in over five years.
vendor_reported_treat_as_directional: Faros AI: PR review time up 441.5 percent, incidents per PR up 242.7 percent
CodeRabbit: AI PRs averaged 1.7x more issues, security vulnerabilities up 2.74x
pyrefly speed figures, TypeScript 7 10x, Qwen and Mistral SWE-bench numbers

governing_principle.statement: The constraint is verification, not generation.
governing_principle.derivation: Every 2026 dataset agrees that AI raises change volume faster than review and testing absorb it. A solo operator has no second reviewer, so the highest-value investment is deterministic gates that reduce review load, not faster code generation.
governing_principle.corollary: Keep automated gate false positives below roughly 10 percent, the Google Tricorder threshold, or you will begin ignoring your own gates. Prune rules before that happens.
